youtube.title: Myth: AI video means credits and API keys. This Short used neither, on 4 CPU cores
youtube.description:
Myth: AI video means credits and API keys.
Fact: funkbox runs on your own computer: no account, no API key, no credits. No video model either; motion comes from shaders, stills from FastSD. This Short rendered in under 40 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
